reason: The hypothesis proposes a new intervention—applying uniaxial compressive stress during RTA to pure FeCoNi—to induce anisotropic lattice distortions and low-symmetry ordering, which is not reported in any passage. It combines the known effect of RTA on coercivity (from FeCoNiMnCu) with a stress-driven mechanism to engineer anisotropy in a simpler, previously unstudied alloy, going beyond the literature's focus on composition changes or Pt addition.
